title: voice.cast.failed.v1
description: Published when a TTS synthesis or cast-to-device operation fails.

stage.description: Pipeline stage where the failure occurred.

retryable.description: Whether the operation can be retried.

outcome.description: Fatal = total failure; partial = some devices succeeded.

device_name.description: Friendly name of the target device (if applicable).

text.description: Original text that was being synthesized.

provider_attempted.description: TTS provider that was attempted (flute, ultimate_tts, google_tts).
